About Us

Serving Thistlemere since 1974.

Our Story

Cedar Hollow began as a Bible study of eleven families meeting in a farmhouse on Quillmore Lane. Our current building was finished in 1981 and expanded in 2009 to add the Fellowship Hall and children's wing.

What We Believe

  • God loves every person and invites us into relationship through Jesus.
  • The Bible is God's word and our guide for life and faith.
  • Church is a family: we grow together, serve our neighbors and care for one another.
